description:
`crates/gf2-sim/src/frame_sim.rs:249` is reported to substitute an empty `BitVec` when the hard decoder fails, before `count_bit_errors` runs.

## Background

Reported by the gf2-sim comment sweep. The effect on counted bit errors for failed frames is unverified.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: A failed frame contributes a defined, documented bit-error count, covered by a test.
title: frame_sim substitutes an empty BitVec on hard decode failure
